findings.result: Mobile collapses detail actions into a named More menu with Save/Verify/Report/Embed. A fresh provider-owned REA Chromium scenario independently completed this interaction.

findings.limitation: Initial navigation attempts selected a link while the menu was closed and timed out. The corrected sequence succeeded; this is not evidence of a site defect.

limitations: T3 viewport was measured in page JavaScript; its snapshot raster reports 1280x800 independently of the requested CSS viewport. Native screenshots were inspected but are not used to certify exact pixel geometry.
T3 snapshots cap the accessibility tree near 10 KB and omitted network/action sections. Conclusions use focused DOM reads or the complete requested REA accessibility capture.
Direct terminal script requests returned HTTP 403. Public scripts were acquired through same-origin browser fetch with credentials omitted, returning 200.
44 public script URLs were inventoried; only four relevant scripts were selected for static analysis. REA's complete inventory coverage applies to those four files, not the whole site.
REA did not recover bundled Turbopack module boundaries (modules=0); static endpoint observations are syntax facts, not proof of successful server execution.
REA inspect-analysis-view projection exited 143 without an output file. The static evidence extract is a bounded Python projection of the complete successful original Evidence.
